Reminder.rule1: Every traveler entering Indonesia by air, sea or land needs an All Indonesia arrival card: one online form for immigration, customs and health, which produces a QR code shown on arrival.
Reminder.rule2: The system opens the form only inside the 72 hours before the arrival date. If you try before, the submission is refused. Most travelers only discover this when they sit down to fill it in a week ahead, then forget it in the rush before the flight.
Reminder.rule3: A reminder solves that. Tell us your arrival date and we work out when the window opens for you and send a single email at that moment. Nothing is charged until you decide, inside the window, whether you want our assistance.

Guide.metaDescription: Complete guide to the All Indonesia arrival card: who needs it, the 72-hour window, every step on the portal and app, families, customs and QR problems.
Guide.howToName: How to fill the All Indonesia arrival card on the official portal
Guide.howToDescription: Step-by-step instructions for the Indonesia digital arrival card, from opening the official portal to saving the QR code.
Guide.title: Indonesia arrival card guide: how to fill the All Indonesia form, step by step
Guide.intro1: The All Indonesia arrival card is the digital form every traveler completes before entering Indonesia. It replaced the paper immigration card, the electronic customs declaration (e-CD) and the SATUSEHAT health form with one submission that produces one QR code. It is run by the Directorate General of Immigration.
Guide.intro2: It was phased in during 2025, first at Jakarta (CGK), Bali (DPS), Surabaya (SUB) and the Batam ferry terminals; since 1 October 2025 it is required at every international airport, seaport and land border. It applies to all nationalities, to Indonesian citizens coming home, and to children and infants. It is not a visa. You still need visa-free entry, a visa on arrival or another visa.
Guide.officialApps: Official apps: <play>All Indonesia on Google Play</play> and <store>All Indonesia on the App Store</store>, both published by Direktorat Jenderal Imigrasi.

toc.portal: Step by step on the official portal

before.intro: Fifteen minutes is enough if everything is on the table.

need.passport: Passport, open at the photo page.
need.flight: Flight or ferry number, date, and the airport or port where you first clear immigration.
need.departure: Departure date from Indonesia, even approximate, and your visa type (visa-free, visa on arrival, e-VOA or other).
need.accommodation: Name and address of your first accommodation.
need.email: An email address you can open on your phone. The verification code and the QR code go there.
need.countries: The countries you visited in the last 21 days.
need.goods: What you carry: cash, alcohol, tobacco, gifts, food, and whether you want to register a phone.

before.timing: The portal accepts a card only when the arrival date is within the next 72 hours. Submit earlier and it is refused, because the card is tied to a specific arrival and the data must be current for immigration and health officials. Most people submit one or two days before landing. Do not leave it to the airport: some airlines ask for the QR at check-in, and airport Wi-Fi is slow. Flying in more than three days? <link>Set a free reminder</link> and we email you when your window opens.

device.connection: Use a stable connection. A dropped connection during submission is the usual reason a QR never appears.
device.personalEmail: Prefer a personal email address over a work address with strict filtering.
device.oneCard: One traveler, one card. Filing for several people? Do them one after another with the passports in front of you.

Guide.portalIntro: The web portal at <link>allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id</link> is available in Indonesian, English and Mandarin and does not require an account. This is the flow as documented by immigration offices and travelers in 2025 and 2026. Screen names change from time to time; the order of the sections has not.

open.t: Open the official portal and pick your category
open.d: Go to allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id, switch the language to English if needed and choose the arrival card service. Then select foreign visitor or Indonesian citizen. Indonesian citizens also enter their NIK (national ID number).

email.d: Type the email address where you want the QR code. The portal sends a verification code to it (check on the portal, the flow changes). If nothing arrives within a few minutes, look in the spam folder before requesting a new code.

personal.t: Enter your personal and passport details
personal.d: Scan the machine-readable zone at the bottom of the passport photo page with your camera, or type the details. Check every field: full name as printed, nationality, passport number, date of birth, gender, expiry date and a phone number.

travel.d: Arrival date in Indonesia (the local date, not your departure date), mode of transport, flight or vessel number, port of entry, planned departure date, purpose of visit, visa type and your address in Indonesia. A hotel name and city is accepted.

health.d: State whether you currently have symptoms such as fever, cough or breathing difficulty, and list the countries visited in the previous 21 days. A truthful yes does not refuse entry; it may mean a short check on arrival.

customs.t: Answer the customs and quarantine declaration
customs.d: Declare cash of IDR 100 million or more, goods above the USD 500 allowance, alcohol and tobacco above the limits, commercial goods, animals, plants or fresh food, and your number of bags. Answer yes to the IMEI question only if you want to register a phone for use beyond 90 days.

review.d: Compare the name and passport number on the summary screen with the passport itself. Check the arrival date and port of entry. Submit once.

save.d: The confirmation with the QR code appears on screen and is emailed to you. Download it, take a full-screen screenshot and print a copy if you can.

Guide.appIntro: The app asks the same questions. The difference is that it needs an account and keeps your cards in one place.

install.d: Search for All Indonesia by Direktorat Jenderal Imigrasi on Google Play or the App Store, or use the links above. Ignore look-alike apps.

account.d: Register with your details, an email address and a password, then enter the one-time code sent to that email. Do this at home, before the 72-hour window opens.

start.d: Sign in, choose the arrival card service and your category. Scan the passport with the camera or type the details.

sections.t: Complete the same sections as on the web
sections.d: Travel details, address in Indonesia, health declaration, customs and quarantine. The questions are identical to the portal.

submit.t: Submit and keep the QR in the app
submit.d: The QR code is stored in the app and emailed to you. Screenshot it as a backup so you do not depend on a login at the airport.

appOrWeb.web: Website: a one-off trip, a larger screen, or when the app is crashing. No registration.
appOrWeb.app: App: frequent trips, group filing (travel guides report up to ten travelers per group submission; check the current limit in the app), or having the QR at hand without opening your email. It also offers more languages, including Japanese, Korean, Russian and Arabic.

Guide.family1: The system is built around one card per person. Every traveler, including a baby with their own passport, must have a card in their own name. A parent or group leader can fill them all in. The app has a group option that takes several travelers in one session.
Guide.family2: One warning. Travelers on the Bali forum report that a group submission returned a QR for the leader only, while the other members got an arrival card number but no code. Glitch or design, the safe approach is the same: after submitting, confirm that every person has their own QR. If not, look them up on the <link>retrieve page</link> or submit an individual card for that person.
Guide.familyTipsTitle: Tips for doing several in a row

familyTips.order: Line up the passports in the order you will type them and tick each one off.
familyTips.sameEmail: Use the same email for all cards, then rename each file with the traveler's name.
familyTips.noCopy: Flight, port and address are the same for everyone; never copy a passport number from one card to the next.
familyTips.child: For a child, purpose of visit and address are those of the accompanying adult.

Guide.health: Two things are asked: current symptoms and travel history. Answer yes to symptoms if you have a fever, cough, breathing difficulty or similar signs of infection. Then list the countries visited in the previous 21 days, the incubation period the Ministry of Health uses for the diseases it monitors. A yes may mean a temperature check or a few questions on arrival. A false no is an offence.
Guide.customsIntro: Answer yes if any of these applies to you or to the family you declare for:

customsYes.cash: Cash, cheques or other bearer instruments worth IDR 100 million or more, in any currency.
customsYes.goods: Personal goods worth more than USD 500 in total, or more than 1 litre of alcohol, 200 cigarettes, 25 cigars or 100 grams of tobacco.
customsYes.commercial: Goods for sale or for a business, samples included.
customsYes.prohibited: Narcotics, weapons, ammunition or pornography. These are prohibited outright.

Guide.customsBags: You also state how many bags you have. Full allowances and a quick calculator are on our <link>customs page</link>.
Guide.quarantine: Answer yes if you carry live animals, animal products, plants, seeds, fruit, vegetables or other fresh food. Some need a health or phytosanitary certificate; most are inspected or confiscated. Sealed packaged snacks are usually fine, but answer about what you actually carry.
Guide.imei: A phone bought abroad works on an Indonesian SIM for up to 90 days without registration. Staying longer? Answer yes to the IMEI question and show the QR to the customs officer, who completes the registration. The usual limit is two devices per traveler, and tax may apply above the allowance. Short visits need nothing.

after.qrEmail: The confirmation arrives within minutes. Save the attachment, screenshot the full code and print it if you can. Keep it in one album with your passport photo page.
after.lost: Use the <link>retrieve page on the official portal</link>. It looks up your submission with your passport details and email (check on the portal, the fields may change) and lets you download the card again. In the app, the card stays in your account.
after.airline: The card is an Indonesian requirement, not an airline one, but ground staff on many routes check it before printing a boarding pass. Have the QR open at the counter and at the gate.
after.immigration: At the large airports you go to an autogate if you hold a biometric passport and a visa or exemption the gate supports. Place the passport on the reader, look at the camera, and the system checks that a valid arrival card exists for that passport. If the gate cannot match you, go to a counter and show the QR with your passport. Visa on arrival is paid before immigration; the card does not replace it.
after.customs: After baggage claim, scan the QR at the customs kiosk. Nothing declared and no random check: green channel. Something declared: red channel, where an officer inspects or assesses duty. Keep receipts for expensive items.

noEmail.p: Verification code or QR email never arrives
noEmail.f: Check spam and promotions. Wait five minutes. Confirm the address has no typo. Request a new code once. If a work address filters it, use a personal one.

appCloses.p: App closes when you press Next
appCloses.f: Update the app, restart the phone and retry. If it persists, use the web portal; it produces the same QR code.

loginLoop.p: App loops back to the login screen
loginLoop.f: Sign out, clear the app cache or reinstall, sign in again. Or switch to the web portal.

scanFails.p: Passport scan or photo upload fails
scanFails.f: Lay the passport flat in good light without glare. If it still fails, type the details by hand and check them twice.

tooEarly.f: The form only accepts an arrival date within the next 72 hours. Come back when the window opens.

slow.f: Try early morning or late evening in Indonesian time. Do not resubmit blindly; check the retrieve page to see whether the first attempt went through.

wrongDate.p: QR shows the wrong arrival date
wrongDate.f: Reported after overnight flights: the card shows the day before the date entered. Submit a new card with the correct local date and keep that one.

twice.f: Keep the copy with the correct details and show only that one. Duplicates are not reported to cause refusals.

airline.p: Airline asks for the QR at check-in
airline.f: Common on flights from Singapore, Australia and the Gulf. Have the QR open on your phone before the counter.

oneQr.p: Only one QR arrived for a group
oneQr.f: Look up each traveler on the retrieve page with their passport details. If someone has no card, submit an individual one for them.

name.m: Name does not match the passport
name.c: The card is flagged and you are sent to a manual counter. Copy the name from the machine-readable zone, all given names included, no titles or accents.

passportNumber.m: Passport number typed with 0 instead of O, or 1 instead of I
passportNumber.c: The autogate cannot match you. Read the number from the machine-readable zone and check each character.

date.c: The card may not be valid on the day you land. Use the local date of arrival in Indonesia; on an overnight flight that is the day after departure.

port.c: Officers ask questions and the customs kiosk may not find you. Pick the airport or port where you first clear immigration, not your final destination after a domestic connection.

unofficial.m: Using an unofficial paid site that looks official
unofficial.c: You pay for a free form and hand your passport data to strangers; fake follow-up emails asking for more money often follow. Type allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id yourself and use only the official apps.

customs.c: Undeclared cash or goods can be fined or seized. Read the customs questions before you travel and check the allowances on our customs page.

oneQr.m: One QR for the whole family
oneQr.c: Each traveler must be matched to a card. Make sure every person, infants included, has a card in their own name and their own QR.

screenshot.m: Screenshot cropped or too small to scan
screenshot.c: The kiosk cannot read it and you queue again. Keep the original file and a screenshot showing the whole code, with screen brightness up.

email.c: No verification code and no QR. Type the address twice and check it before you continue.

visa.q: Is the All Indonesia arrival card a visa?
visa.a: No. It is a declaration to immigration, customs, health and quarantine. You still need visa-free entry, a visa on arrival, an e-VOA or another visa, depending on your nationality.

cost.a: No. The card is free on the official portal and in the official app. Any site that charges for the card itself is unofficial. Our fee pays for preparing, checking and delivering it on your behalf.

when.a: Inside the 72 hours before your arrival date in Indonesia. Earlier submissions are refused. Most travelers submit 24 to 48 hours before landing.

children.q: Do children and infants need one?
children.a: Yes. Every traveler with a passport needs a card, whatever their age. A parent can fill it in for them.

citizens.a: Yes. Citizens returning from abroad complete the same card, choosing the Indonesian citizen category and entering their NIK.

transit.q: I am only transiting. Do I need it?
transit.a: If you stay in the international transit area and do not pass immigration, no. If you clear immigration, even for one night, yes.

print.q: Do I need to print the QR code?
print.a: No. A digital copy on your phone is accepted. A printout is a useful backup if your battery or signal fails.

lost.q: I lost the QR code. What now?
lost.a: Use the retrieve page on the official portal with your passport details to download it again, or open the app where it is stored.

onArrival.q: Can I fill it in on arrival?
onArrival.a: In practice yes, on your phone in the arrivals hall, but it is slow and some airlines ask for it before boarding. Do it before you fly.

airports.q: Which airports and ports use it?
airports.a: All international airports since 1 October 2025, including Jakarta, Bali, Surabaya, Medan, Makassar, Manado and Labuan Bajo, plus international seaports such as the Batam and Bintan ferry terminals and Benoa, and land borders such as Motaain.

appOrWeb.q: Should I use the app or the website?
appOrWeb.a: Either. The website needs no account and works on any device. The app stores the QR and suits repeat trips and groups, but it requires registration and has had crashes.

airport.a: At immigration you scan your passport at an autogate or hand it to an officer; the system finds your card. After baggage claim you scan the QR at the customs kiosk and take the green or red channel.

Customs.metaDescription: What you must declare when entering Indonesia: USD 500 personal goods allowance, alcohol and tobacco limits, IDR 100 million cash rule, phone IMEI registration.
Customs.title: Indonesia customs allowances and what to declare
Customs.intro: Summary of the rules applied by Bea Cukai (Indonesian Customs) for arriving passengers. Always check the <link>official customs site</link> for the latest figures.

goods.exceeded: Import duty and taxes on the excess

tobacco.allowance: 200 cigarettes, or 25 cigars, or 100 g tobacco

cash.exceeded: Must be declared; penalties for non-declaration

phones.allowance: Max 2 devices; IMEI registration required to use an Indonesian SIM beyond 90 days
phones.exceeded: Register at customs on arrival; tax may apply above allowance

Customs.quickCheck: Quick check: do I need to declare?

calculator.bio: I carry animals, plants, seeds, or fresh food products
calculator.flagGoods: Personal goods above the USD 500 allowance: duty applies on about USD {excess}.
calculator.flagAlcohol: Alcohol above 1 litre: the excess will be confiscated.
calculator.flagCigarettes: More than 200 cigarettes: the excess will be confiscated.
calculator.flagCash: Cash of IDR 100 million or more must be declared on the arrival card.
calculator.flagPhones: More than 2 phones exceeds the passenger allowance; tax will be assessed.
calculator.flagBio: Animals, plants or fresh food products must be declared for quarantine inspection.
calculator.nothing: Nothing to declare based on these answers. Answer “no” to the customs questions on the arrival card.
calculator.indicative: Indicative only. Customs officers make the final decision.

News.title: Official news, summarized for travelers
News.intro: Short English summaries of announcements published by the Indonesian immigration and customs authorities. Each item links to the original. We are not the source and do not speak for these authorities.

arrivalCard.title: All Indonesia arrival card is mandatory at all international entry points
arrivalCard.text: Since 1 October 2025 every international arrival must submit the digital arrival card within 72 hours before arrival and present the QR code with their passport.

cash.title: Cash of IDR 100 million or more must be declared
cash.text: Bringing IDR 100,000,000 or more (or foreign currency equivalent) into or out of Indonesia requires a declaration to Customs.

Faq.metaDescription: Answers about the All Indonesia arrival card: who needs it, the 72-hour rule, the QR code, customs and our assistance service.
Faq.title: Frequently asked questions

fee.a: Guided data collection, manual verification of every field, submission of your arrival card, delivery of the QR code by email, and support until you have cleared immigration.

who.a: All international arrivals to Indonesia by air, sea or land, including Indonesian citizens and children. Each traveler needs their own card.

when.a: Within 72 hours (3 days) before your scheduled arrival. Submitting earlier than 72 hours is not accepted by the system, so we schedule your submission inside that window.

receive.a: A QR code, which you show with your passport at immigration and customs on arrival. We send it by email as a PDF and an image.

visa.q: Does the arrival card replace a visa?
visa.a: No. It is an arrival declaration (immigration, customs and health in one form). You still need visa-free entry, a Visa on Arrival, an e-VOA or another visa as applicable. We can prepare the e-VOA for you as well.

evoa.q: What is the e-VOA and who can use it?
evoa.a: The electronic Visa on Arrival is a 30-day visa, extendable once for 30 days, available to around 97 nationalities for tourism, family visits, business meetings and transit. ASEAN nationals do not need it. Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months.

evoaPrice.q: How is the e-VOA price made up?
evoaPrice.a: The government e-VOA fee of IDR 500,000 (about USD 31) is shown separately from our service fee. The government fee is non-refundable once the application is lodged; our service fee is refunded if you are not eligible or we cannot submit.

evoaTime.q: How long does the e-VOA take?
evoaTime.a: Usually the same day, at most 2 working days after we submit. Apply at least 5 days before travel to be safe; the express option prioritizes verification and submission.

airports.q: Which airports and ports use it?
airports.a: All major international entry points, including Jakarta (CGK), Bali (DPS), Surabaya (SUB), Medan (KNO), Makassar (UPG) and the Batam and Tanjung Pinang ferry terminals. Some airlines ask to see the QR before boarding.

mistake.q: What if I make a mistake?
mistake.a: Details such as passport number must match exactly. That is the main reason people use our service: a person checks every field before submission.

safety.a: Data is encrypted, used only to prepare your card, never sold, and deleted 30 days after your arrival date. See our privacy policy.

refund.a: Yes, in full if we do not deliver at least 6 hours before your arrival time or if you cancel before processing starts.

government.a: No. We are a private assistance company, not affiliated with the Government of Indonesia, the Directorate General of Immigration or any government website.

diy.q: Can I complete the arrival card without your service?
diy.a: Yes. The All Indonesia arrival card can be completed free of charge on the official government portal allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id. Our fee is only for preparing, checking and delivering it for you.

privacy.metaDescription: How Arrival Card Assist collects, uses, stores and deletes your passport and travel data, and your rights under Hong Kong and Indonesian law.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.template: Template for legal review before launch. Last updated: {date}.
privacy.collect1: Identity and passport details of each traveler (name, date of birth, gender, nationality, passport number and dates), and for e-VOA orders a scan of the passport bio page and a passport-style photo.
privacy.collect2: Travel details (dates, flight, port of entry, accommodation) and the health and customs declarations you make.
privacy.collect3: Contact details (email, phone) and order records. Card details are processed by our payment provider and never stored by us.
privacy.purpose: To perform the contract you place with us: preparing and submitting your arrival card and delivering the result. Also to comply with legal obligations (accounting, fraud prevention) and, with your consent, to send service reminders.
privacy.sharing: Your data is entered into the official Indonesian government portal to submit your arrival card. It is also processed by our hosting, database, email and messaging providers under data-processing agreements. We never sell personal data.
privacy.transfers: Data is stored in Singapore and processed by our team in Hong Kong and Indonesia. Transfers are protected by contractual safeguards meeting the standards of Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law and the GDPR.
privacy.retention: Passport and declaration data, including uploaded passport scans and photos, is deleted 30 days after your arrival date. Order and payment records are kept for 7 years as required by accounting law, without passport data.
privacy.rights: You may request access, correction, deletion or a copy of your data, withdraw consent and lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. Write to <mail>{email}</mail>. We respond within 3 working days.
privacy.security: Encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access for our team, audit logs, and breach notification to affected persons and authorities within the legally required period (3×24 hours under Indonesian law).
privacy.cookies: We use Google Analytics 4 and the Meta (Facebook) Pixel, including their server-side interfaces (Google Analytics Measurement Protocol and Meta Conversions API), to measure visits and advertising conversions. For a completed order we send Google and Meta the order value and a hashed (irreversible) version of your email address, phone number, name and nationality, together with your IP address, browser identifier and advertising click identifiers, so that the advertising platforms can attribute the purchase to an advertisement. Nothing about your passport or your declarations is sent to them. You can opt out through the settings of those platforms or by using a browser that blocks their scripts.

refunds.metaDescription: When you get a full or partial refund for arrival card and e-VOA assistance orders, including cancellations and our own errors.
refunds.title: Refund policy

items.deadline: Missed deadline: full refund, automatically, if your QR code is not delivered at least 6 hours before your scheduled arrival.
items.cancelBefore: Cancellation before processing: full refund if you cancel before a team member has started your order. Email us with your order number.
items.cancelAfter: Cancellation after processing: 50% refund if the card has not yet been submitted; no refund once the QR code has been delivered.
items.noLongerNeeded: You no longer need the service: full refund if you tell us before we submit.
items.tooEarly: Ordered too early: we do not take payment for arrival cards more than {hours} hours before arrival. If a payment slips through, we hold the order and process it when the window opens, or refund in full on request before we start.
items.evoaFee: e-VOA visa fee: non-refundable once the application is lodged with the Indonesian authorities. Refunded in full if we have not yet lodged it.
items.evoaRefused: e-VOA not eligible or refused: full refund of our service fee; the visa fee is refunded only if not yet lodged.
items.ourError: Our error: full refund plus a free resubmission if a mistake on our side causes the card to be rejected.

refunds.timing: Refunds are returned to the original card within 5–10 business days.
refunds.disputes: If something goes wrong, contact us at <mail>{email}</mail> before opening a dispute with your bank. We answer within one business day and resolve almost every case with a refund or a resubmission. A chargeback opened without contacting us first may be contested with the order record, the delivery email and the <terms>terms of service</terms>.

terms.metaDescription: Terms of service for Arrival Card Assist: what we do, prices, delivery times, refunds, liability and governing law.
terms.title: Terms of service
terms.template: Template for review by a Hong Kong solicitor before launch. Last updated: {date}.
terms.s1: These terms govern the assistance service (the "Service") provided by {company} ("we", "us"), {jurisdiction} ({reg}) with its registered office at {address}, to the person placing an order ("you"). The Service consists of collecting your information through our guided form, checking it, submitting the Indonesia arrival card on the official government portal on your behalf, and delivering the resulting QR code to you.
terms.s2: We are not affiliated with, endorsed by or acting for the Government of Indonesia, and this website is not a government website. You are paying for our assistance only. We do not guarantee entry to Indonesia, which is at the sole discretion of Indonesian authorities.
terms.s3: The price is displayed before you enter personal data and again at checkout. Payment is taken by card through our payment provider. The charge appears on your statement under our company descriptor, never as a government fee.
terms.s4: You must provide accurate information and hold authority to provide the information of other travelers in your booking. You remain responsible for the accuracy of the declarations (customs, health, immigration) made in your name.
terms.s5a: Standard delivery is within {acStandard} hours for arrival cards and within {evStandard} hours for e-VOA verification; Express delivery is within {acExpress} hours for arrival cards and within {evExpress} hours for e-VOA verification.
terms.s5b: Standard and Express delivery times run from the later of: (a) confirmation of your payment, (b) receipt of every detail and document we need, and (c) for arrival cards, the opening of the official {window}-hour window. Express ({acExpress} hours for arrival cards, {evExpress} hours for e-VOA verification) applies to our preparation and submission; the authorities' own processing time for the e-VOA is outside our control.
terms.s5c: If we do not deliver your arrival card QR code at least 6 hours before your scheduled arrival, you receive a full refund. See the <link>refund policy</link>.
terms.s6a: The official portal accepts arrival card submissions only within {window} hours before arrival. Our order form does not take payment for arrival card assistance before that window opens; instead it offers a free reminder, and we email you when the window opens.
terms.s6b: If, despite this, an order is accepted outside the window (for example a bundle whose e-VOA part is processed immediately), the arrival card part is prepared as soon as the window opens, and the delivery times in section 5 count from that moment.
terms.s6c: If you change your arrival date, you must tell us before we submit. If a card is submitted for a date that you later change, a new submission is a new order.
terms.s7: We process personal data as described in the <link>privacy policy</link>, including the requirements of Indonesia's Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection, the Hong Kong Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance and, where applicable, the GDPR.
terms.s8: Our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid for the Service. We are not liable for refusal of entry, airline decisions, changes in government rules, or outages of the official portal, except where caused by our negligence.
terms.s9: If something goes wrong, contact us at <mail>{email}</mail> before opening a dispute with your bank. We answer within one business day and resolve almost every case with a refund or a resubmission. A chargeback opened without contacting us first may be contested with the order record, the delivery email and this agreement.
terms.s10: These terms are governed by the laws of Hong Kong SAR. Disputes are subject to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the Hong Kong courts. Consumers keep any mandatory protections of their country of residence.
